description: This Java class represents credentials containing username and password information for device authentication in the Eclipse Hono framework. It includes logic for parsing credentials in single tenant or multi-tenant mode, and provides accessors for password and credential type.

classes.name: UsernamePasswordCredentials
classes.description: A helper class that encapsulates username/password credentials with logic to handle multi-tenant and single-tenant configurations, suitable for device authentication within Hono.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new UsernamePasswordCredentials object based on username, password, and tenant mode (single or multi). It parses the username to extract tenant ID in multi-tenant mode or sets a default tenant in single-tenant mode.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the credentials type constant indicating it is a hashed password type.

methods.name: getPassword
methods.description: Returns the password stored in the credentials object.
